articles.title: Sleepy Rams look little like Super Bowl favorite as they get blasted by 49ers in Australia - Yahoo Sports
articles.description: The 49ers spent a week in Australia getting acclimated to the time difference and it showed.
articles.content:
Jet lag begins the season 1-0.
